twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.introTotp: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code it shows for this site.
twoFactor.introRecovery: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you turned on two-step verification. Each one works only once.
twoFactor.invalidCode: That code is not right, or it was already used. Wait for the next one and try again.
twoFactor.invalidRecoveryCode: That recovery code is not right, or it was already used.
twoFactor.expired: This sign-in took too long or had too many wrong tries. Please start over.

passkey.failed: Could not use a passkey. Try again, or sign in with your password.
passkey.rejected: That passkey was not accepted. Try another one, or sign in with your password.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.intro: Enter the e-mail address of your account and we will send you a link for choosing a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account uses that e-mail address, we have sent it a link for choosing a new password. It works for an hour. It can take a few minutes to arrive, check the spam folder too.

signUp.intro: Accounts on this site are made from DeviantArt accounts. Sign in with {provider} and your account is created from your {provider} name, nothing else to fill in.
signUp.noPassword: There is no password to make up, you sign in with {provider} each time. You can add a password, a passkey or two-step verification in your account settings afterwards.
